The '''Rescued Property Appreciation Society''' was a secret underworld [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]]' bazaar that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
